fields.summary_ko.0: SPCX surged from an initial $135 to over $200 after its June IPO but has since declined to around $140, with 27 out of 33 analysts recommending Buy and only 1 recommending Sell.
fields.summary_ko.1: CFRA's Keith Snyder is the sole bearish analyst with a $115 price target, noting that SpaceX's AI division (accounting for $26.5T of a $28.5T total addressable market) is key to justifying the high valuation.
